lyrics:
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia,
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

1. The Lord is ever faithful and loving in His deeds.
0 happy those who hear His word with loving care.

2. The Word of God is truth, it gives eternal life,
0 harden not your hearts, but listen to His voice.

3. Accept the Word of God, for what it really is,
The Word of God almighty, and not our human words.
